content.answer_markdown: The Research Tilt is bounded by a limit of 2.0 percentage points (pp). This means that any tilt applied to the portfolio allocation based on approved research insights cannot exceed 2.0 pp in either direction from the target allocation.

claims.text: The Research Tilt is clipped by the engine to the configured bound of 2.0 percentage points.
